structured.feedback: Length (~210 words), Markdown, subheadings, CTA, and omission of weaknesses are all fine, but the prompt requires active voice and several sentences are passive ("Each handle is made from," "are designed to help," "Each brush is individually numbered," "are made from petroleum"). It also never clearly separates features from benefits, and some phrasing is generic ("Shop With Confidence," "practical alternative").
